query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_APPLICANT (APPLICANT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT APPLICANT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_APPLICANT WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT APPLICANT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_APPLICANT WHERE APPLICANT_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_APPLICANT SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE APPLICANT_ID = ?
